title: Rereading feels like learning. Testing is.
summary: Trying to recall information strengthens memory far more than rereading it. In a classic study, students who practised recall remembered much more a week later.

scenes.text: Rereading your notes feels productive. Testing yourself actually is.

Tested five minutes later, rereading looked slightly better.
scenes.reveal: But one week later, the recall group remembered much more.

scenes.text: After a week, the self-testers recalled 56% of the material — the rereaders 42%.
